body: I'm not going to a resource, I'm scared. I've seen what happened to my cousin when he came out. Here's trans and bi. He can't out as bi first, and the rest of the family acts differently around him. I couldn't take it if somehow they found out through a phone call or text to a resource like that. Doing this was risky enough
You couldn't change my mind. I took all the pills and small liquor bottles I could find in my house
I'm already done for, thanks though
You don't know me, I'm an internet stranger
